strings.zh: 迷思 1：香港腳是穿不透氣的鞋子造成的
strings.en: Myth 1: Athlete's foot is caused by non-breathable shoes

strings.zh: 迷思 2：灰指甲塗藥膏每天擦就會好
strings.en: Myth 2: Daily topical creams will cure onychomycosis

strings.zh: 迷思 3：香港腳跟家人住一起一定會傳染
strings.en: Myth 3: Athlete's foot will definitely spread to family members

strings.zh: 迷思 4：熱水泡腳 / 醋泡腳 / 鹽水泡腳能殺菌治香港腳
strings.en: Myth 4: Hot water, vinegar, or saltwater foot soaks can kill the fungus

strings.zh: 迷思 5：灰指甲不痛不癢，反正不影響生活就不用治
strings.en: Myth 5: Onychomycosis doesn't hurt, so it doesn't need treatment

strings.zh: 迷思 6：口服抗黴菌藥傷肝，絕對不要吃
strings.en: Myth 6: Oral antifungals destroy the liver — never take them

strings.zh: 迷思 7：寵物身上的黴菌不會傳給人
strings.en: Myth 7: Pet ringworm doesn't transmit to humans

所以預防策略是「避免接觸 + 保持乾燥」雙管齊下，不只是「換透氣鞋」就完事。
strings.en: So prevention requires both "avoiding contact" and "keeping dry" — not just switching to breathable shoes.

strings.zh: 治療早期灰指甲 3-6 個月可治好，拖到 10 根全灰需要 9-12 個月，費用與時間成本都翻倍。
strings.en: Early-stage onychomycosis can clear in 3–6 months; once all 10 nails are involved, treatment takes 9–12 months and both cost and time double.

strings.zh: 不適合口服的族群：嚴重肝病、心衰竭(itraconazole 禁忌）、孕婦、哺乳期、與多種藥物有交互作用的人。請與醫師討論。
strings.en: Not suitable for oral therapy: severe liver disease, heart failure (contraindication for itraconazole), pregnancy, breastfeeding, or significant drug interactions. Discuss with your physician.

strings.zh: 寵物相關皮癬菌感染特徵：
嚴重者可考慮：雷射、化學去甲、外科拔甲（僅嚴重感染拒絕口服者）
strings.en: Severe cases may consider: laser, chemical avulsion, or surgical nail removal (only for severe infections refusing oral therapy)

strings.zh: 共用拖鞋、襪子、毛巾、指甲剪
strings.en: Sharing slippers, socks, towels, or nail clippers

strings.zh: 共用浴室地板（尤其潮濕磁磚）、地毯
strings.en: Shared bathroom floors (especially damp tile) or carpets

strings.zh: 傳到頭皮：斷髮、禿斑、有時化膿 — 頭癬，兒童特別容易
strings.en: Spread to scalp: hair breakage, bald patches, sometimes pus — tinea capitis, especially in children

strings.zh: 寵物先看獸醫治療（口服 + 外用）
strings.en: Treat the pet first via veterinarian (oral + topical)

strings.zh: 家人外用 azole 類抗真菌藥膏 2-4 週
strings.en: Family members apply topical azole antifungal cream for 2–4 weeks

strings.zh: 環境消毒：吸塵 + 漂白水稀釋擦地板，寵物用品（籠子、毯子）用熱水或丟掉
strings.en: Environmental disinfection: vacuum + diluted bleach on floors; wash pet items (cages, blankets) in hot water or discard
Most people use the wrong approach
Diagnosis requires KOH microscopy or culture

strings.zh: 每種型態治療策略不同

strings.en: The real cause is fungal infection

strings.zh: 是否曾接觸過菌、皮膚屏障狀態、免疫力
strings.en: prior fungal exposure, skin barrier integrity, and immune status

strings.zh: 多數中重度灰指甲塗藥膏無效
strings.en: Most moderate-to-severe onychomycosis does NOT respond to topical creams

strings.zh: 一般皮膚藥膏（克黴速、療霉舒霜等）塗在指甲上幾乎無效
strings.en: Generic skin creams (Canesten, Lamisil cream, etc.) applied to nails are nearly useless

strings.zh: 專門設計的「指甲油劑型」
每天 1 次連續用 48 週
無法殺死躲在角質深處的菌絲
strings.en: cannot kill hyphae embedded deep in keratin

strings.zh: 原本肝功能正常的人，因抗黴菌藥造成嚴重肝損傷的機率非常低
strings.en: In patients with normal baseline liver function, severe antifungal-induced hepatotoxicity is very rare

strings.zh: Microsporum canis 是貓最常見的皮癬菌，會跳到主人身上
strings.en: Microsporum canis, the most common cat dermatophyte, transmits to owners

strings.zh: 沒明顯症狀但仍是帶原者
圓形紅斑伴隨脫皮、邊緣比中央紅（類似戒指）
strings.en: Round red patch with scaling, edges redder than center (ring-like)
Don't go barefoot in public spaces
Treat at first sign of abnormality

strings.zh: 口服 Terbinafine 250 mg/天：足甲 6 週、趾甲 12 週療程，新指甲長出來看到變化要 6-9 個月（指甲生長慢）
strings.en: Oral terbinafine 250 mg/day: 6 weeks for fingernails, 12 weeks for toenails. Visible change in new growth takes 6–9 months (nails grow slowly)

strings.zh: 塗藥膏就好？熱水殺菌？不痛就不用治？
strings.en: Just apply cream? Hot water kills it? No pain, no treatment?

strings.zh: 肝毒性 ~0.1-0.5%、味覺變化偶發、需注意藥物交互作用
strings.en: Hepatotoxicity ~0.1–0.5%, occasional taste disturbance, mind drug interactions

strings.zh: 200 mg 一天 2 次，連 1 週後停 3 週（脈衝療法）
strings.en: 200 mg twice daily for 1 week, off 3 weeks (pulse therapy)

strings.zh: 足甲 / 趾甲皆 3-4 個 cycle
strings.en: 3–4 cycles for both fingernails and toenails

strings.zh: 有心衰竭者禁用、藥物交互作用多、飯後吃
strings.en: Contraindicated in heart failure; many drug interactions; take with food

strings.zh: 較少用於灰指甲，香港腳有時用
strings.en: Less commonly used for nail fungus; sometimes for athlete's foot

strings.zh: 外用 Terbinafine 1% / Clotrimazole 2 週，治好後再擦 1 週
strings.en: Topical terbinafine 1% / clotrimazole for 2 weeks; continue 1 week after clearance

strings.zh: 同上 + 改善穿鞋通風
外用抗真菌 + 短期低強度類固醇（降發炎)1 週
strings.en: Topical antifungal + short course of low-potency corticosteroid (anti-inflammatory) for 1 week

strings.zh: 外用尿素 / 水楊酸軟化角質 + 抗真菌藥膏 4-6 週
strings.en: Topical urea / salicylic acid keratolytic + antifungal cream for 4–6 weeks

strings.zh: Efinaconazole 油劑 / Amorolfine 油劑 48 週
strings.en: Efinaconazole solution / amorolfine lacquer for 48 weeks

strings.zh: 灰指甲（中重度,>50% / 多甲）
口服 Terbinafine 250 mg/day，足甲 6 週、趾甲 12 週
strings.en: Oral terbinafine 250 mg/day; 6 weeks for fingernails, 12 weeks for toenails

strings.zh: + Itraconazole 脈衝、雷射、化學去甲
strings.en: + Itraconazole pulse therapy, laser, chemical avulsion

strings.zh: 外用 azole 抗真菌 2-4 週
頑固或大面積 → 口服
